# Nymrel Proof Ledger (@nymrel/proof-ledger / nymrel_proof_ledger)

> Zero-dependency dual-language (TypeScript + Python) cryptographic attestation and proof-of-execution protocol library and CLI.

## Entity Graph
- Entity: Nymrel Proof Ledger
- Protocol: nymrel-proof-ledger
- Version: 1.0.0
- Parent Organization: Nymrel
- Ultimate Parent Entity: JalenBuilds LLC
- Contact: contact@nymrel.com
- License: MIT

## Purpose & Capabilities
Nymrel Proof Ledger provides mathematical certainty and verifiable cryptographic proof for autonomous AI agent actions, build pipelines, financial calculations, data migrations, and container runs.

- Zero runtime dependencies in both Node.js (TypeScript) and Python 3.9+.
- RFC 6962 Domain-Separated Merkle Trees (Leaf prefix `0x00`, Node prefix `0x01`) to eliminate second-preimage collision attacks.
- RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) guaranteeing identical byte-level serialization across runtimes.
- Dual-Algorithm Cryptographic Signatures: Symmetric HMAC-SHA256 and Asymmetric Ed25519.
- Self-Contained Visual Proof Badges: Responsive SVG cards and HTML certificates with embedded vector QR codes and JSON-LD schema metadata.
- CLI Tool: `proof-ledger` (Node) / `proof-ledger-py` (Python) with commands `attest`, `verify`, `badge`, `inspect`, `keygen`, and `export`.

## Machine Verification Endpoints
- Public Verification Web Gateway: https://proofs.nymrel.com/v/:proofId
- JSON-LD Schema: `https://schema.org/DigitalDocument`
- RDF Namespaces: `xmlns:nymrel="https://nymrel.com/ns#"`

## TypeScript Integration
```ts
import { attestExecution, verifyProof, generateBadge } from '@nymrel/proof-ledger';

const receipt = await attestExecution({
  task: { name: 'Model Evaluation Gate', status: 'SUCCESS' },
  artifacts: [{ path: 'eval_results.json' }],
  signingKey: process.env.PROOF_KEY!,
  signerIdentity: 'nymrel-eval-agent',
});

const verification = await verifyProof(receipt, { publicKeyOrSecret: process.env.PROOF_KEY });
const svgBadge = generateBadge(receipt);
```

## Python Integration
```python
from nymrel_proof_ledger import attest_execution, verify_proof, generate_svg_badge

receipt = attest_execution(
    task={"name": "Data Migration", "status": "SUCCESS"},
    signing_key="secret_key_hex",
    signer_identity="db-worker",
    artifacts=[{"path": "migration.sql"}]
)

result = verify_proof(receipt, public_key_or_secret="secret_key_hex")
badge_svg = generate_svg_badge(receipt)
```
